notes: Summary: Wardenshield is a mid-sized DoD contractor building cross-agency intel search for classified documents. Primary need: high-recall RAG search with embeddings + neural reranker, strict air-gapped on-prem deployment inside partner SCIF.

Scale: aiming to index ~200M documents (mix of PDFs, msgs, TL;DRs). Expect ~100k queries/day at peak, heavy burst patterns during incident response. Want cost per query < $0.05 if possible (budget-driven).
Latency targets: P50 < 200ms for single-turn queries, P95 < 700ms with reranking; acceptable to trade some latency for cost if within SLA. Prefer < 500ms end-to-end for most ops.

Model preferences: open-models preferred (no outbound model API calls). Interested in quantized LLMs for reranking (7B-13B variants) and optimized embedding models that run on local GPUs. Need support for multiple model variants and automatic fallback when capacity constrained.

Security: must run entirely air-gapped, no egress; KMS/HSM FIPS-140 for key material; audit log retention 7+ years; NIST 800-53 controls baseline requested. SSO not required inside SCIF but admin plane should integrate with SAML when outside the enclave.

POC asks: 3-week pilot to validate index pipeline + reranker with 5M docs, measure embedding throughput, CPU/GPU requirements, and per-query cost model. Proof points: indexing throughput (docs/sec), recall@10, reranker lift, and end-to-end latency distribution.

Procurement notes: contracting officer involved; procurement timeline 6-9 months; price is important but security/compliance are gating. NDA executed 2025-11-30. SOW must include ATO assist and supply-chain disclosures.
